72720442.name: Iron(II,III) sulfide
72720442.description: Iron sulfide is a blue-black chemical compound of iron and sulfur with formula Fe3S4 or FeS·Fe2S3, which is much similar to iron oxide.

91886522.name: Cobalt lactate
91886522.description: Cobalt lactate is a chemical compound, a salt of cobalt and lactic acid with the formula Co 2.

101262010.name: Lysergyl-alanine
101262010.description: Lysergyl-alanine, or lysergylalanine, is an ergot alkaloid and biosynthetic intermediate of other ergot alkaloids like ergine , lysergic acid hydroxyethylamide , and ergometrine.

101282746.description: Tungsten chloride is the inorganic compound with the formula W6Cl12.

101602874.description: Vanadium fluoride is a fluoride of vanadium, with the chemical formula of VF2. It forms blue crystals.

121488186.name: Troriluzole
121488186.description: Troriluzole is an experimental medication that has been investigated as a potential treatment for Machado–Joseph disease , obsessive–compulsive disorder ,, spinocerebellar ataxia , and glioblastoma.

135894458.name: Gymnochrome E
135894458.description: Gymnochrome E is a cytotoxic phenanthroperylenequinone isolated from a deep-water crinoid called Holopus rangii.

137700154.name: WOBE437
137700154.description: WOBE437 is a selective endocannabinoid reuptake inhibitor which has been used in scientific research.

138395194.name: Strontium disilicide
138395194.description: Strontium disilicide is a binary inorganic compound of strontium and silicon with the chemical formula SrSi2.

155280058.name: Tivoxavir marboxil
155280058.description: Tivoxavir marboxil is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated by Traws Pharma, Inc. for the treatment of influenza. It is a cap-dependent endonuclease inhibitor.

165360186.name: Dysprosium stannate
165360186.description: Dysprosium stannate is an inorganic compound consisting of dysprosium, tin, and oxygen.

172873530.name: HTL26119
172873530.description: HTL26119 is a drug which acts as a potent and selective negative allosteric modulator behaving as a functional antagonist of the glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor .

347909946.name: Ancrod
347909946.description: Ancrod is a defibrinogenating agent derived from the venom of the Malayan pit viper.

900000186.name: Apiogalacturonan
900000186.description: Apiogalacturonans are a type of pectin found in the cell walls of Lemna and Zostera marina.

900000442.name: Cerium monosulfide
900000442.description: Cerium monosulfide is a binary inorganic compound of cerium and sulfur with the chemical formula CeS. This is the simplest of cerium sulfides.

900000570.name: Datopotamab deruxtecan
900000570.description: Datopotamab deruxtecan, sold under the brand name Datroway, is an anti-cancer medication used for the treatment of breast cancer.

900000698.name: Eftilagimod alpha
900000698.description: Eftilagimod alpha is a large-molecule cancer drug being developed by the clinical-stage biotechnology company Immutep.

900001082.name: Knölker complex

900001594.name: Polonium monoxide
900001594.description: Polonium monoxide (also known as polonium oxide) is a chemical compound with the formula PoO.

900001722.name: Protactinium triiodide
900001722.description: Protactinium triiodide is an inorganic chemical compound with the chemical formula PaI3.

900001850.name: Saruplase
900001850.description: Saruplase is a fibrinolytic enzyme. It is closely related to urokinase.

900001978.name: Technetium (99mTc) fanolesomab
900001978.description: Technetium fanolesomab (trade name NeutroSpec, manufactured by Palatin Technologies) is a mouse monoclonal antibody formerly used to aid in the diagnosis of appendicitis.

900002106.name: Ucenprubart
900002106.description: Ucenprubart is a monoclonal antibody that acts as an agonist at CD200R1 and is developed by Eli Lilly and Company for atopic dermatitis and other autoimmune diseases.
